entries.en: Added the Monitor tool and plugin monitors on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, and when telemetry or nonessential traffic is disabled; long foreground sleeps are now blocked there too
entries.zh: 添加了对 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 以及遥测或非必要流量禁用时的监控工具和插件监控；长时间的前台睡眠现在也被阻止了

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Added Claude Code cloud sessions and Remote Control permissions to Enterprise custom roles, so Owners can control access to each by role
entries.zh: [云会话] 为企业自定义角色添加了 Claude Code 云会话和远程控制权限，因此所有者可以按角色控制对每个会话的访问

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Added a Choose file button to load a cloud environment's setup script from a file
entries.zh: [云会话]添加了一个选择文件按钮以从文件加载云环境的设置脚本

entries.en: Improved auto mode's prompt before the first read outside the working directories: it now says when blocking those reads makes shell commands ask for permission
entries.zh: 改进了在工作目录之外第一次读取之前自动模式的提示：现在它会说，当阻止这些读取时，会使 shell 命令请求权限

entries.en: Improved memory use of non-interactive sessions (`-p`, Agent SDK) during compaction when the transcript file is very large
entries.zh: 当转录文件非常大时，改进了压缩过程中非交互式会话（`-p`、Agent SDK）的内存使用

entries.en: Improved a mod's `Image` to draw inside tmux with `allow-passthrough` and `focus-events` on, in kitty, Ghostty, and iTerm2 3.5+ with fullscreen rendering, where it showed only its `alt` text
entries.zh: 改进了 mod 的`Image`，以便在 kitty、Ghostty 和 iTerm2 3.5+ 中使用`allow-passthrough`和`focus-events`在 tmux 内进行全屏渲染，仅显示其`alt`文本

entries.en: Linux: Improved `/sandbox` and the sandbox startup warning to name Ubuntu's AppArmor restriction on user namespaces, and how to lift it, when it keeps bubblewrap from starting the sandbox
entries.zh: Linux：改进了`/sandbox`和沙箱启动警告，以命名 Ubuntu 的 AppArmor 对用户命名空间的限制，以及当它阻止 bubblewrap 启动沙箱时如何解除它

entries.en: Changed the error for an MCP tool call that times out in a non-interactive session while the server's elicitation is unanswered: it now tells Claude that no answer came and not to repeat the call
entries.zh: 更改了 MCP 工具调用在服务器的引出未得到应答时在非交互式会话中超时的错误：它现在告诉 Claude 没有应答，不要重复调用

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Improved the session start checklist to show a cloud environment's setup script output in a scrolling box
entries.zh: [云会话] 改进了会话启动清单，以在滚动框中显示云环境的设置脚本输出

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Changed turning on Cloud sessions or Remote Control in admin settings to ask for confirmation and list the custom roles that have that permission
entries.zh: [云会话] 更改了在管理设置中打开云会话或远程控制以要求确认并列出具有该权限的自定义角色

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Changed the cloud environment dialog to open network access, setup script and environment variables from rows instead of listing every editor at once
entries.zh: [云会话] 更改了云环境对话框以从行中打开网络访问、设置脚本和环境变量，而不是一次列出每个编辑器

entries.en: [Code Review] Improved the Code Review admin section to retry the first load and show one Try again banner when it still fails
entries.zh: [代码审查] 改进了代码审查管理部分，以重试第一次加载，并在仍然失败时显示重试横幅

entries.en: Fixed requests failing behind some gateways and compatible servers that reject the `effort-2025-11-24` beta value or mid-conversation system messages; Claude Code now retries without them
entries.zh: 修复了拒绝`effort-2025-11-24`测试值或对话中系统消息的某些网关和兼容服务器后面失败的请求；克劳德代码现在在没有它们的情况下重试

entries.en: Fixed background cleanup deleting some recent files, such as pasted images, when `cleanupPeriodDays` is set to a very large value
entries.zh: 修复了当`cleanupPeriodDays`设置为非常大的值时，后台清理会删除一些最近的文件，例如粘贴的图像

entries.en: Fixed compaction after a "Prompt is too long" error keeping too much of a conversation with dense text, such as base64 or SVG, so the next request could fail again
entries.zh: 修复了“提示太长”错误后的压缩，使过多的对话与密集文本（例如 base64 或 SVG）保持一致，因此下一个请求可能会再次失败

entries.en: Fixed file read permission prompts not showing where a symbolic link leads
entries.zh: 修复了文件读取权限提示不显示符号链接的位置

entries.en: Fixed a question's auto-continue timeout firing the moment the external editor closed after a long edit
entries.zh: 修复了外部编辑器在长时间编辑后关闭时触发问题的自动继续超时的问题

entries.en: Windows: Fixed PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks letting a tool call through when Git Bash is missing and the hook's command is only quoted strings, such as a quoted path
entries.zh: Windows：修复了 PreToolUse 和 PermissionRequest 挂钩，让工具在缺少 Git Bash 且挂钩的命令仅为带引号的字符串（例如带引号的路径）时调用

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed pressing Enter on the plan review card's "Send feedback and keep planning" button approving the plan instead of sending your comments back
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了在计划审核卡的“发送反馈并继续计划”按钮上按 Enter 键批准计划而不是发回您的评论的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the panel showing "Something went wrong" after "Switch branch & continue" on a cloud session opened from Session history's Web tab
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了在从会话历史记录的 Web 选项卡打开的云会话上“切换分支并继续”后显示“出现问题”的面板

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed failed saves and archives in the cloud environment edit dialog showing no error inside the dialog
entries.zh: [云会话] 修复了云环境编辑对话框中保存和存档失败的问题，显示对话框内没有错误

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed failed routine API token actions showing only a toast; the error now appears in the routine edit dialog
entries.zh: [云会话] 修复了失败的例程 API 令牌操作仅显示 toast 的问题；错误现在出现在例程编辑对话框中

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag treating `!` commands such as `!restart` and `!help` as ordinary messages when sent in bold, italic or strikethrough
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复了 Claude Tag 在以粗体、斜体或删除线发送时将 `!` 命令（例如 `!restart` 和 `!help`）视为普通消息的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag admin channel and workspace pages being replaced by a load error when a background refresh of the bundle list fails
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复了当捆绑列表后台刷新失败时 Claude Tag 管理频道和工作区页面被加载错误替换的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings reporting that no channels match a filter while channel names are still loading
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复了管理设置中 Claude Tag 的支出限制页面报告在频道名称仍在加载时没有频道与过滤器匹配的问题

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed the Code Review admin section hiding its repositories and switches after a failed refresh of the repository list
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复了 Code Review 管理部分在存储库列表刷新失败后隐藏其存储库和切换的问题
